To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the BPI 23 gene and the Fcγ1 gene were isolated by RT-PCR from HL60 and normal human blood leukocytes, respectively, and inserted into the pBV expression vector.
BPI 23 was successfully expressed in E. col i and the expressed protein had anti bacteria activities.
BPI 23-Fcγ1 fusion proteins were successfully produced by recombinant technology and expressed in E. colii DH5α.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction of a recombinant expression system for BPI 23.
the construction of expression vector of BPI 23-Fcγ1 and the expression of the fusion protein in E.coli.
the expression of BPI 23 in E. coli and its biological activities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
BPI 23-Fcγ1 recombi-nant expression vector pBV BPI600Fcγ1700 was successfully constructed and the recombinant protein was expressed in E coli.
the recombinant Bpi 23 Fc γ 1 fusion protein is successfully expressed and purified.
this is the first report of BPI 23 fusion protein expression.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have successfully constructed the recombinant Bactericidal/permeability increasing protein BPI 23 gene expression vector, which could express the BPI 23 protein in E. colii and we have successfully constructed Bactericidal /permeability increasing protein 23 Fc fusion protein gene expression vector, and the fusion protein could be expressed in E. colli.
the BPI 23 gene was cloned from HL 60, BPI 23 recombinant expression plasmid pBV BPI was constructed and BPI 600 fusion protein with biological activities was expressed in DH5α
we successfully constructed the expression vector of recombinant fusion proteins of human BPI and Fcγ 1, expressed the recombinant fusion gene in E. coli, and purified the fusion proteins.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the BPI 23 gene can be expressed in bacteria and its biological function can be preserved.
BPI 23 can be expressed in E. col i and that BPI 24 Fcγ1 can be expressed in a temperature induced system.
we have developed a recombinant expression system for the production of the BPI 23-Fcγ1 fusion proteins in E. coli.
